description: A WARNING received from a peer is never answered with a WARNING, and a PADDING D_PDU is ignored, so nothing is queued.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10: a WARNING (type 15, RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 7, reason 2) and a PADDING (type 14). The WARNING goes to the CAS as D_WARNING_RECEIVED (C-0589), which has no output, and is never answered (C-0393); the PADDING is ignored (C-0588). Nothing is queued, so the burst end starts no csma.vdcd_end, unlike warning-reason-1-arq-while-unconnected.
